blockingFindings.title: Gate defer references artifacts that do not exist for all tracked gate phases
blockingFindings.body:
**Target:** R3/R4 Data Flow
**Issue:** The spec says every semantic gate retry exhaustion writes flow-findings entries that reference source gate artifacts, and the Data Flow says a review/gate run writes its existing artifact. In the current code, only integration gate persists a gate artifact (`impl-gate-result.json` via `persistIntegrationGateResult`); draft/spec gate failures are returned from `run-gate` and recorded in issue-log/runtime state, but no durable gate artifact with stable finding ids is written.
**Required change:** Specify the durable source for deferred draft/spec gate findings, either by requiring bounded gate result artifacts for all retry-tracked flow gate phases or by explicitly narrowing defer to phases with persisted artifacts and defining an alternate reference source for the others.
**Why blocking:** Without a persisted sourceArtifact/sourceFindingId for draft/spec gate failures, implementers cannot create auditable flow-findings references or design acceptance-review tests that reload the original gate finding text without duplicating it.

blockingFindings.title: Deferred completion conflicts with existing completion contracts
blockingFindings.body:
**Target:** R1/R2/R3/R8
**Issue:** The spec requires deferred semantic review/gate exhaustion to advance traversal while retaining existing review/gate artifacts. Existing completion validation in `flow-judgment-contract.js` only allows `impl-review`/`test-review` to be marked done for PASS/ADVISORY artifacts and `impl-gate` for pass artifacts. A retained FAIL/fail artifact with blocking findings will be rejected when lifecycle tries to mark the step done.
**Required change:** Define the spec-level completion contract for retry-exhausted semantic defer, including how the retained FAIL/fail artifact, flow-findings entry, and step completion validation interact.
**Why blocking:** Leaving this unspecified makes the required traversal advance fail at the existing step-completion guard, or pushes implementers toward falsely rewriting detector artifacts as pass, which would weaken audit and final review behavior.

blockingFindings.title: Final disposition ownership conflicts between artifacts
blockingFindings.body:
**Target:** R4/R5 Constraints
**Issue:** R4 requires flow-findings.json to record finalDisposition, while the constraints state acceptance-review.json is the source of truth for final finding disposition and flow-findings.json is only input history. Those two requirements conflict unless finalDisposition in flow-findings is explicitly non-authoritative or removed.
**Required change:** Specify whether finalDisposition is stored only in acceptance-review.json, or whether flow-findings.finalDisposition is a nullable/non-authoritative mirror derived from acceptance-review.json.
**Why blocking:** If both artifacts can hold finalDisposition without a defined authority rule, implementation and tests cannot determine which value controls routing, reporting, and acceptance-review outcome when the two diverge.

nonBlockingImprovements.title: Clarify task-scope gate exclusion
nonBlockingImprovements.body:
**Target:** R1/R3
**Improvement:** The scope says flow-scope review/gate steps, but existing retry-tracked gate phases include `task-impl` and `resolveRetryMax` switches to task scope when `currentTaskId` is set. Clarifying whether task-gate retry exhaustion keeps current stop behavior would reduce implementation ambiguity.
**Why non-blocking:** The spec can still be implemented for flow-scope gate phases, but an explicit exclusion would prevent accidental behavior changes in task flows.
